planSteps.description: Navigate to `/` on the target preview origin.
The page shows the brand `Mosaic` and the text `Information changes.`
The page shows the button or link `Sign in to your workspace`.
The page shows the three feature headings `Cited to the exact words`, `Nothing moves until you approve` and `Undo that respects later work`.
Navigate to `/` on the target preview origin.
Click the navigation link `How it works`.
The heading `From revised brief to settled work` is visible.
The four steps `Bring a source`, `Review the change`, `Apply with care` and `Keep the history` are visible, in that order.

name: Sign-in page from the landing page

planSteps.description: Navigate to `/` on the target preview origin.
Click the header link named exactly `Sign in`.
The URL path is `/login`.
The heading `Welcome back.` is visible, with an `Email` field, a `Password` field and a `Sign in` button.
There is no option to create an account or register.

name: Signed-out visitor cannot open the workspace

planSteps.description: Navigate to `/app` on the target preview origin without signing in.
The browser ends on the `/login` path.
The heading `Welcome back.` is visible and no task board, workspace selector or `Sign out` button is shown.

name: Judge lobby without a link shows no seats

planSteps.description: Navigate to `/lobby` on the target preview origin, with no `#` fragment.
The heading `Choose a seat` is visible.
The message `This lobby link is invalid or has expired.` is visible.
No seat buttons (for example `Seat 1`) are shown.

name: Access link page without a token is refused

planSteps.description: Navigate to `/access` on the target preview origin, with no `#` fragment.
The heading `Link not accepted` is visible.
The message `This access link is invalid or has expired.` is visible.
No task board or `Sign out` button is shown.

name: Landing: review preview shows a cited change

planSteps.description: Navigate to `/` on the target preview origin.
The preview card shows `Launch brief` and `Version 2`.
It shows the old line `Launch on 22 October.` and the new line `Launch on 29 October, after the security review.`
It shows the proposals `Due date Oct 22 → Oct 29` and `Book security review`, each with a quoted passage, and the receipt line `1 change applied · receipt saved · undo available`.

name: Landing: See how it works jumps to the steps

planSteps.description: Navigate to `/` on the target preview origin.
Click the button `See how it works`.
The URL ends with `#how`.
The heading `From revised brief to settled work` is visible.
Navigate to `/` on the target preview origin.
Scroll to the footer and click `Sign in to Mosaic`.
The URL path is `/login` and the heading `Welcome back.` is visible.
Navigate to `/login` on the target preview origin.
Enter `nobody@example.test` in the `Email` field and `not-a-real-password-123` in the `Password` field.
Click the `Sign in` button.
The message `Email or password is incorrect.` is visible.
The URL path is still `/login` and no `Sign out` button is shown.

name: Signed-out deep links redirect to sign-in

planSteps.description: Navigate to `/app/sources` on the target preview origin without signing in.
The browser ends on the `/login` path with the heading `Welcome back.`
Navigate to `/app/changes`.
The browser ends on the `/login` path.
Navigate to `/app/activity`.
The browser ends on the `/login` path.

name: Judge lobby rejects a made-up link

planSteps.description: Navigate to `/lobby#not-a-real-link` on the target preview origin.
The heading `Choose a seat` is visible.
The message `This lobby link is invalid or has expired.` is visible.
No seat buttons (for example `Seat 1`) are shown.

name: Access page rejects a made-up token and hides it

planSteps.description: Navigate to `/access#not-a-real-link` on the target preview origin.
The heading `Link not accepted` and the message `This access link is invalid or has expired.` are visible.
The address bar no longer contains `not-a-real-link`.
No task board or `Sign out` button is shown.
Navigate to `/no-such-page` on the target preview origin.
The text `404` and `This page could not be found.` are visible.
No workspace content or `Sign out` button is shown.

name: Lobby removes the link from the address bar

planSteps.description: Navigate to `/lobby#not-a-real-link` on the target preview origin.
Wait until the lobby page has finished loading and shows its message.
The heading `Choose a seat` is visible.
The browser address bar URL does not contain `not-a-real-link` and has no `#` fragment; the private link has been removed from the address bar.
